claims.value: Inspector Lane and one constable; foyer cordoned with tape
claims.quote: Inspector Lane stood in the small foyer with her collar up, a constable behind her, the hall already marked off with a strip of tape that had more dignity than utility.

claims.value: Don't touch anything until forensics are here, Ellis
claims.quote: “Don’t touch anything until forensics are here, Ellis,” she said when she saw me.

claims.value: Anna Rowe found Lucius Harben at his desk and summoned the police
claims.quote: Anna Rowe met me at the study door. She had been the one to find him.

claims.value: study door shut and locked from inside with brass key in lock
claims.quote: The study door was shut. A heavy brass key sat in its lock, the metal dulled by years of handling and scored along one edge.

claims.value: in the study door lock on the study side
claims.quote: A heavy brass key sat in its lock, the metal dulled by years of handling and scored along one edge.

claims.value: oil, paper, and faint tang of metal
claims.quote: The room beyond smelled of oil and paper and a faint, sharp tang of metal.

claims.value: against the far wall of the study
claims.quote: The longcase clock took up the far wall, an upright thing of walnut and gilt that pulled the light toward it.
Its hands were frozen at eleven seventeen; the pendulum hung motionless, a dark tongue.

claims.value: rear access panel ajar with latch crooked
claims.quote: the access panel at the rear of the case was a hair ajar, a sliver of inner brass visible where the latch sat crooked.

claims.value: missing from display; empty mount labelled 'IVORY REVOLVER'
claims.quote: One mount was empty. A little brass label under the gap read IVORY REVOLVER in neat type; the mounting beneath it showed the ghost of a shape, the crushed velvet where the grip had rested.

claims.value: seated at his desk with shoulders folded forward, fingers curled over a torn scrap
claims.quote: Lucius Harben sat at his desk with his shoulders folded forward as if in sleep. The back of his head caught the light; his fingers curled over a torn scrap.
In his palm was a torn note, no larger than my thumb. The fragment I could see read, simply, do not wind.

claims.value: neat, round mark on the blotter beside his hand consistent with a single shot
claims.quote: A neat, round mark on the wood, the kind a single shot makes, stained the blotter beside his hand.

claims.value: tangled at base of longcase clock
claims.quote: At the base of the clock, tangled in the carved scrollwork, a black thread hung, waxed and stiff.
The windows were latched and the glass unbroken.
